name: Tooltip
description: Radix tooltip primitive set (Provider, Trigger, Content) for icon hints.

ariaRequirements: opens on hover AND keyboard focus of the trigger
content is linked to the trigger via aria-describedby (Radix)
content must be supplementary — never put essential or interactive content in a tooltip
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-03 (batch 4) — hover+focus trigger, Escape dismiss, and aria-describedby wiring asserted in the play function and unit tests; axe clean on Default/Placements/WithIconButton. 2026-07-05 (alpha→beta) — the pending light/dark + forced-colors verification is now done: axe-clean on Default/Example/ForcedColors via test-storybook; light + dark eyeballed (bubble uses --color-primary and inverts correctly, arrow tracks the bubble); emulated forced-colors shows a CanvasText-bordered Canvas bubble with readable CanvasText, no reliance on a background that disappears; enter/exit animation drops under reduced-motion (CSS @media).

forbiddenUse: put interactive content (links, buttons) inside a tooltip; it cannot be reached by keyboard or touch — use a Modal or disclosure instead.
use a tooltip as the only label of a control; give the control a real accessible name and let the tooltip add detail.
attach tooltips to non-focusable elements; hover-only hints exclude keyboard and touch users.
prefersOver: title attribute (unstyled, mouse-only, slow to appear)
dense: Radix tooltip set: Provider (delayDuration) > Tooltip > Trigger asChild + Content (side top|right|bottom|left); opens on hover+focus, Escape dismisses, aria-describedby wired

usage.description: Tooltip is the composed Radix primitive set for supplementary hints on focusable controls — most often icon-only buttons. Wrap a subtree in `TooltipProvider` (sets `delayDuration`, default 200ms), then per hint: `Tooltip` (open state) containing `TooltipTrigger asChild` around the real control and `TooltipContent` with the text and a `side` placement (top by default, flips when out of room). It opens on hover and keyboard focus, dismisses on Escape, and Radix links the content to the trigger via aria-describedby. The content is description, not a name: the trigger still needs its own accessible label.

bestPractices.description: Wrap the trigger with asChild so your real Button/IconButton receives the tooltip wiring instead of a nested extra button.
Use one TooltipProvider per surface (page or toolbar) so the open delay is shared and hopping between adjacent triggers feels instant.
Keep content to a short phrase; the tooltip supplements the control's accessible name (aria-describedby), it does not replace it.
Pick side by surrounding space; Radix flips automatically when the preferred side runs out of room.
Do not put links, buttons, or anything interactive inside TooltipContent — it is unreachable by keyboard and touch.
Do not rely on a tooltip as the only label of an icon-only control; give the control aria-label and use the tooltip for the visible hint.

anatomy.name: TooltipProvider
anatomy.description: Context host setting delayDuration (default 200ms); one per surface, not per tooltip.

anatomy.name: Tooltip
anatomy.description: Radix Root owning open state; supports open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange for controlled use.

anatomy.name: TooltipTrigger
anatomy.description: Wraps the focusable control (use asChild); receives hover/focus handlers and aria-describedby.

anatomy.name: TooltipContent
anatomy.description: Portaled bubble with arrow; side sets preferred placement, sideOffset the gap; fade/scale animation drops under reduced motion.
